BrowserActor.description: Verified human session lookup and HTTP context; never a public body.
BrowserActor.title: BrowserActor

BrowserContext.description: Trusted HTTP adapter projection; CSRF comparisons must be constant-time.
BrowserContext.title: BrowserContext

BrowserWorldDefinition.description: Sensitive author input/granted output. Never an agent-safe catalog projection.
BrowserWorldDefinition.title: BrowserWorldDefinition

CreateWorldVersionRequest.description: First version uses null/zero; later versions use the exact displayed head.
CreateWorldVersionRequest.title: CreateWorldVersionRequest

GrantAuthority.description: Incarnation advances on remove/regrant; membership revision is ordinary CAS.
GrantAuthority.title: GrantAuthority

GrantedWorldDefinition.description: Sensitive browser output only after actual current version-specific recipient grant.
GrantedWorldDefinition.title: GrantedWorldDefinition

LawSpec.description: Private configuration: never include this in an observation message.
LawSpec.title: LawSpec

Membership.description: Current application grant, loaded independently of credential claims.
Membership.title: Membership

OriginalExecutionAdmission.description: Original atomic producer record, never assembled from a launch caller's current values.
OriginalExecutionAdmission.title: OriginalExecutionAdmission

PreviewGrantLookup.description: Scoped partial persistence evidence; runtime must reject missing/inconsistent closure.
PreviewGrantLookup.title: PreviewGrantLookup

PreviewGrantRecord.description: Private recipient ancestry; issuer audit is distinct from current recipient authority.
PreviewGrantRecord.title: PreviewGrantRecord

PreviewGrantView.description: Safe management metadata exposes CAS revision, never law, seed or definition digest.
PreviewGrantView.title: PreviewGrantView

PreviewMutationCommit.description: Immutable metadata-only receipt plus atomic grant transition. Not an authority proof.
PreviewMutationCommit.title: PreviewMutationCommit

RunOwnership.description: Immutable admission record; creator leaf credentials are audit metadata only.
RunOwnership.title: RunOwnership

SessionCredential.description: Trusted hash lookup result, including narrowly retained logout-only history.
SessionCredential.title: SessionCredential

SessionRecord.description: Current server session family; no opaque cookie secret is stored here.
SessionRecord.title: SessionRecord

WorkspaceAuthority.description:
Complete current owner set from the same locked workspace revision.

SQL producers establish completeness and currency under the shared lock.
active_owner_ids counts active human owner membership rows; disabled_owner_ids
identifies rows whose principals are currently disabled. During security fan-out,
stored workspace state can lag; composed authorization checks both facts.
WorkspaceAuthority.title: WorkspaceAuthority

WorldActorAncestry.description: Historical issuer/author audit identity; never current recipient authorization.
WorldActorAncestry.title: WorldActorAncestry

WorldBrowserAuthority.description: Current C2 human identity + workspace snapshot; shape is not complete authorization.
WorldBrowserAuthority.title: WorldBrowserAuthority

WorldCatalogEligibility.description: Trusted current catalog decision for NEW run selection only, not an author preview grant.
WorldCatalogEligibility.title: WorldCatalogEligibility

WorldExpiredMutation.description: Private uniqueness tombstone for the retained namespace lifetime, not deletion authority.
WorldExpiredMutation.title: WorldExpiredMutation

WorldPolicy.description: Configured bounds and current role policy; no production defaults or client control.
WorldPolicy.title: WorldPolicy

WorldReceiptExpiration.description: Original full receipt to exact tombstone proposal; no cleanup or deletion authorization.
WorldReceiptExpiration.title: WorldReceiptExpiration

WorldRunSelection.description: Retained exact selection; later catalog withdrawal does not rewrite an admitted run.
WorldRunSelection.title: WorldRunSelection

WorldVersionCommit.description: Immutable atomic version/head/receipt proposal; no DB writes or authorization.
WorldVersionCommit.title: WorldVersionCommit

WorldVersionLookup.description: Partial states stay representable for later recovery checks, never normalized to absence.
WorldVersionLookup.title: WorldVersionLookup

WorldVersionRecord.description: Immutable private definition. This record is world-owned, never a fake run artifact.
WorldVersionRecord.title: WorldVersionRecord

WorldVersionView.description: Agent-safe immutable version metadata; titles are author-supplied, not a blindness proof.
WorldVersionView.title: WorldVersionView
